facts.name: width
facts.doc: the width of the launch's level, a real width: the matcher pads it to the width class that selects the arm (common/plan/entmax_launch.h)

facts.name: levels
facts.doc: the levels one launch solves, one CTA row of the grid each; they share one width class

facts.name: logit_dtype
facts.doc: the element type of the logit plane the solve reads (or, for a backward, the logit gradient it writes)

facts.name: value_dtype
facts.doc: the element type of the route values the solve writes (or, for a backward, reads)
